archetypes.name: dyn-bg-hooks
archetypes.rationale: Marker and sentinel hook changes are race-sensitive.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed bg-wait marker lifecycle across Python and shell boundaries. Focus on whether each marker is armed at the true outer background boundary, whether cleanup writes the intended terminal sentinel before marker removal, and whether symlink sentinels stay rejected. Check that implement fences did not accidentally gain foreground probe allowances except Step 8. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-bg-lint
archetypes.rationale: The new structural lint must catch real regressions without flagging illustrative docs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new bg-wait coverage lint and its wiring. Focus on whether it scans the intended skill surfaces, maps current background launch commands to marker-backed steps, and avoids false positives for illustrative placeholders or foreground instructions. Check Makefile, pre-commit, and relevant-check routing consistency. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
